result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor visual inconsistency.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with both the image and the restaurant name truncated. This indicates a horizontal overflow or carousel that doesn't visually communicate scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible scroll indicator, fade effect, or partial card peek to signal to users that the list is horizontally scrollable. Ensure the truncated text has an ellipsis and the card peek is intentional and consistent.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off vertically at the bottom of the screen without any visual cue indicating more content below, which may confuse users.
issues.suggestion: Ensure partially visible cards have enough of the image/content visible to clearly signal scrollability, and consider adding a subtle shadow or fade at the bottom to indicate more content.
